mainEntity.name: How long does it take to plan and build a multigenerational addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multigenerational addition timelines vary depending on whether the project involves a standard ground-floor bedroom suite or an extensive multi-room layout. Once design plans and local building permits are secured, physical construction typically progresses through foundation prep, framing, mechanical rough-ins for plumbing and electric, insulation, drywall hanging, and interior finishing. Adding dedicated kitchenettes or custom tile walk-in showers can extend the schedule due to specialized trade sequencing. A detailed consultation establishes a realistic timeline for your specific scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction timelines depend on project scope, from permitting and foundation work to drywall and finish installations, with exact schedules determined during consultation.
